inputs.text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday. It requires new registered voters to prove they are United States citizens to vote in state elections. The bill applies only to state elections and affects only new registrants.

output.main_topic: Senate Bill 175 requires new registered voters to prove citizenship to vote in South Dakota state elections.
subtopics: The bill applies only to state elections.
The bill affects only new registrants.

central_relations.subject: Senate Bill 175
central_relations.object: new registered voters to prove they are United States citizens to vote in state elections

output.narrative_frame: A state voting bill is framed as a citizenship-proof requirement limited to state elections and new registrants.
